notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.3.0

NEW FEATURE
Contagious cosmetics
With this new feature players can collect and upgrade items, improving their appearance. Items can also be gained by colliding with players who are wearing an item you do not own, creating a copy of the item at a lower quality. Items will be upgraded by earning points through gameplay and reaching the upgrade threshold. When colliding with another player while wearing the same item you will steal points if they are a higher quality tier.

We will be giving items to "Hosts" to spread throughout the player base.

UI

 Added notification in lobby if players have low or poor connection
 Added notification in lobby and in the join menu if the lobby has custom settings set
 Lobbies are removed from the join list if they are full
 Small UI updates
